claims.claim: Three transports selected by ServerConfig fields: stdio (Command), Streamable HTTP (URL), HTTP+SSE (TransportName sse)
If the server refuses the Streamable HTTP POST with 400, 404 or 405, the client falls back to HTTP+SSE
With TransportSSE, URL is the SSE endpoint; a URL that does not serve the stream is retried with /sse appended and a warning is logged
Client asks server/discover first; 2026-07-28 servers are stateless, others get the initialize handshake; HTTP+SSE never sends discovery
Stdio server that never answers discovery is restarted with the handshake after EraProbeTimeout (3s default)
DisableModernProtocol skips the discovery probe
mcp.NewRegistry, RegisterServer(ServerConfig{Name,Command,Args,Env}), ListAllTools, Close
tools.NewMCPExecutor(registry); toolRegistry.RegisterExecutor; Register ToolDescriptor Mode mcp
stage.NewProviderStage(provider, toolRegistry, &pipeline.ToolPolicy{ToolChoice,MaxRounds,MaxToolCallsPerTurn}, config)
Filesystem server tools: read_file, write_file, list_directory, create_directory, delete_file
Memory server tools: store_memory, retrieve_memory
toolRegistry.Execute(toolDescriptor, args) returns result
RequestTimeout applies to every request on every transport; ServerConfig.TimeoutMs overrides it; MaxRetries/RetryDelay double on each retry
A request past RequestTimeout is canceled with ErrServerUnresponsive; timeout paused during elicitation
Progress notifications restart a tools/call timeout; caller context still bounds the call
Retries apply only to connecting; server errors and refused authorization are not retried; tools/call never retried
Lost connection reconnects on next request up to MaxReconnectAttempts
ElicitationHandler advertises elicitation only when set; form mode only; defaults filled; same handler answers input_required
Authorizer interface (Authorize, Challenge), AuthChallenge fields, three challenges then *AuthError
sdk.WithMCPAuthorizer(func(server string) mcp.Authorizer) and sdk.WithMCPElicitation
RegistryOptions.ConfigureClient sets Authorizer and ElicitationHandler per server
OnToolsChanged runs on its own goroutine with the full list; keeps old tools if re-read fails
SDK updates conversation and forks next turn; mcp__<server>__* entries
EnableGracefulDegradation default returns no tools on failed tools/list and ListAllTools omits the server, with a warning
SDK turns degradation off; retries unlisted servers 1s to 1min until answered or conversation closes
registry.GetToolSchema(ctx, name) returns the Tool
Error check strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not found") detects an unregistered server
*mcp.RPCError for protocol errors; IsError for tool failures
ListAllTools empty: force initialization with GetClient
Env: map in ServerConfig sets server process environment
